description: Evaluates an arithmetic expression safely (no code execution): + - * / % ^ !, parentheses, percentages like '15% * 80', and functions sqrt, abs, round, floor, ceil, ln, log, log2, exp, trig, min, max, pow, hypot, with constants pi and e. Returns the numeric result. Use it when an exact result is needed instead of mental math. Limits: no variables, symbolic algebra or units.
name: calculate
title: Calculator
